nodes.label: Knowledge Graph / Obsidian Vault Workflow
nodes.rationale: Explore the project through graphify queries and the Obsidian vault before reading source files, to cut token usage; refresh the graph and vault after every code or doc change so the vault never goes stale.

nodes.label: Closure Model Replaces Camp Sessions
nodes.rationale: A Closure is a date range in which the whole center (RoomId null) or one room is unavailable; it replaced the earlier fixed camp-session (turnus) model so bookings can span arbitrary date ranges.

nodes.label: GiST Exclusion Constraint Against Double Booking
nodes.rationale: btree_gist exclusion on (RoomId, daterange[StartDate,EndDate)) enforces non-overlap at the database level; half-open ranges let a checkout and a check-in share a day without colliding.
nodes.norm_label: gist exclusion constraint against double booking

nodes.label: Security Requirements
nodes.rationale: Bcrypt passwords, refresh-token rotation with reuse detection, per-IP rate limiting, server-side amount computation, and SHA-384-verified idempotent P24 webhooks.

nodes.label: Guest Booking Flow
nodes.rationale: Guest picks dates and headcount, gets availability and price, adjusts the suggested room split, and receives an e-mail management link; a paid deposit confirms the booking, unpaid ones are released after 7 days and the balance is due 30 days before arrival.

nodes.label: Przelewy24 Payments and Webhook
nodes.rationale: The webhook must be publicly reachable (tunnel in dev); amounts are always computed server-side and confirmed via transaction/verify before the booking is marked paid.

nodes.label: Production Deployment (Caddy + Docker Compose)
nodes.rationale: Caddy obtains Let's Encrypt certificates for DOMAIN; production data lives in a separate campcenter-db-prod volume.

nodes.label: Pre-Paint Theme Restore
nodes.rationale: The saved theme is read from localStorage and written to document.documentElement.dataset.theme before first paint to avoid a light-to-dark flash; light is the fallback.

nodes.label: Lakeside Typography (Bricolage Grotesque + Inter)
nodes.rationale: Display and UI fonts come from Google Fonts; icons are inline SVG so no icon web-font is loaded.
